## Plan: Refine context menu — consistent single-function approach, exclude reader

**TL;DR** — The native context menu is already a single function (`registerContextMenu` in the main process). The fix is to conditionally show "Select All" (only when there's editable content or selected text), and suppress the context menu in the reader viewer. Both changes use the same cross-platform Electron/DOM APIs.

**What's already in place:**
- `registerContextMenu` in `apps/desktop/src/main/index.ts` is already the single function that creates ALL native right-click menus (text boxes, selected text, etc.). Every native context menu uses the same `Menu`/`MenuItem` Electron API, so font, size, and color are already identical across the app — they render as OS-native menus.

**Steps**

### Phase 1: Fix orphaned "Select All" (main process)
1. In `apps/desktop/src/main/index.ts`, inside `registerContextMenu`, move the "Select All" `MenuItem` inside the existing `if (params.isEditable)` / `else if (params.selectionText)` block. Currently it's appended unconditionally after the conditional, causing a lone "Select All" popup when right-clicking on non-editable, non-text elements. After the fix, the menu only appears when there's something meaningful to act on (a text input, textarea, or selected text).

### Phase 2: Suppress context menu in reader only (renderer)
2. In `apps/desktop/src/renderer/components/reader/ReaderViewer.tsx`, add `onContextMenu={(e) => e.preventDefault()}` to the viewer container `<div>` (the one with `ref={viewerContainer}` and `className={cn(styles.container, ...)}`). This blocks the native context-menu event from firing inside the reader, while leaving it fully functional everywhere else (text boxes in Add/Edit Series, description blocks, selected text on any page).

**What this preserves:**
- Right-click in all text inputs/textarea (Add Series, Edit Series, description block, settings fields) → Cut/Copy/Paste/Select All
- Right-click on selected text anywhere (library, search, settings, etc.) → Copy/Select All
- All menus rendered from the same `registerContextMenu` function → identical OS-native appearance

**What this removes:**
- Right-click on reader images → no menu (was showing orphaned "Select All")

**Relevant files**
- `apps/desktop/src/main/index.ts` — lines ~107-113: wrap the unconditional `menu.append(new MenuItem({ label: 'Select All', ... }))` inside the `if/else if` block
- `apps/desktop/src/renderer/components/reader/ReaderViewer.tsx` — line ~293: add `onContextMenu` to the viewer container `<div>`

**Verification**
1. `corepack pnpm lint` — no lint errors
2. `corepack pnpm --filter @houdoku/desktop build` — TypeScript compiles clean
3. `corepack pnpm --filter @houdoku/desktop dist:win` — release build succeeds
4. Manual: right-click in Add Series text fields → Cut/Copy/Paste/Select All works
5. Manual: select text on library page, right-click → Copy/Select All works
6. Manual: right-click on reader image → no popup appears
7. Manual: right-click in series description block → Cut/Copy/Paste/Select All works

**Cross-platform** — Both `contextmenu` DOM event and Electron `Menu`/`MenuItem` APIs behave identically on Windows, macOS, and Linux.

**In the main process** (index.ts):

```js
ipcMain.on('show-context-menu', (event, info) => {
  const window = BrowserWindow.fromWebContents(event.sender);
  if (!window) return;
  
  const template = [
    { label: 'Cut', role: 'cut', enabled: info.isEditable },
    { label: 'Copy', role: 'copy', enabled: info.isEditable || info.selectionText.length > 0 },
    { label: 'Paste', role: 'paste', enabled: info.isEditable },
    { label: 'Delete', role: 'delete', enabled: info.isEditable },
    { type: 'separator' },
    { label: 'Select All', role: 'selectAll', enabled: true },
  ];
  
  const menu = Menu.buildFromTemplate(template);
  setTimeout(() => {
    menu.popup({ window, x: info.x, y: info.y });
  }, 0);
});
```

```js
const registerContextMenu = (window: BrowserWindow) => {

    const menu = new Menu();

      menu.append(new MenuItem({ label: 'Cut', role: 'cut', enabled: params.editFlags.canCut, visible: params.isEditable }));
      menu.append(new MenuItem({ label: 'Copy', role: 'copy', enabled: params.editFlags.canCopy, visible: params.isEditable }));
      menu.append(new MenuItem({ label: 'Paste', role: 'paste', enabled: params.editFlags.canPaste, visible: params.isEditable }));
      menu.append(new MenuItem({ type: 'separator' }));
    } else if (params.selectionText.trim().length > 0) {
      menu.append(new MenuItem({ label: 'Copy', role: 'copy', enabled: true }));
    }

    menu.append(new MenuItem({ label: 'Select All', role: 'selectAll', enabled: params.editFlags.canSelectAll }));
    menu.popup();
  });
};
```
